matches.tactical_summary: South Africa executed a disciplined tactical plan, absorbing pressure and capitalizing on a swift counter-attack in the second half. Despite dominating possession, South Korea struggled to break down the resilient South African defense and lacked a decisive cutting edge in the final third.

narrative: South Africa secured a historic 1-0 victory over South Korea, with Thapelo Maseko's second-half goal sending them into the World Cup knockout stages for the first time ever. This result means South Africa finishes second in Group A, while South Korea now faces an anxious wait to see if their three points and -1 goal difference are enough to qualify as one of the best third-placed teams.
